author: Pat DesLauriers
text:
I'm on Medicare (so can't get Libre discount coupons)and my Type 2 is covered. Doctor had to state I had experienced low glucose that required multiple daily finger sticks and that CGM was medically necessary. 
You might want to appeal and have your doctors reword why you need the sensors using Medicare guidelines (these work for many other types of insurance).
Hope you can get insurance to cover cost.
